correctness.rationale: Each edge Laplacian vector projected onto E+ and E− yields two universal bounds lambda2<=N/(m−1) and lambda2<=2A/m+(m−2)N/[m(m−1)]. Positive combination / budget proves piecewise optimal value without imposing symmetry. The class-constant W spectrum 0, mb (m−1), 2a+(m−2)b (m−1), 2[a+(m−1)b] attains bounds. Tight E− trace forces (D_L+W)x=lambda*x for all x perp 1; two-index differences imply every off-matching rate b and every matching rate a, so equality rigidity classifies ALL unrestricted optima. Independent 378 fresh random nonsymmetric eigenvalue/price regime checks and boundary calculations corroborate the argument.
residual_risks: Finite tests corroborate but do not replace the analytic infinite/domain-general proof.
